state.description: Rebuilding section of line between Hooks and Thurmond. Approximately 2.3 miles. The line will be rebuilt on existing R/W using steel poles, 115 kV insulation, and 1272 ACSR conductor.
state.need: This project is required to address end of life and reliability issues on these lines.

q.instructions: Does the stated project need contradict the project description?

criteria.true: The need talks about equipment or work that the description and title never mention (likely copied from another project).
criteria.false: The need is generic (load growth, reliability, end of life) or matches the described work.
